title: Febe Viewport Snaps Ortho Smarttrack
summary: Snap kinds and SmartTrack already existed from OM9-L2-02-03. Added Project mode, a clickable active-state snap palette, the SmartTrack on/off control with all-view guides, End/Mid one-shot shortcuts and their indicator, plus focused evidence.

gaps_found: Project was a disabled palette label with no Controller flag or projection path.
Snap palette icons could not display off/on state while remaining clickable.
SmartTrack had no on/off control and guides painted only in the active view.
No End/Mid keyboard shortcuts or one-shot indicator.
A focused command editor could swallow the shortcut if it were routed naively.

code_changes: crates/om9-app/src/session.rs: project flag, project_to_plane, Project in constrain_point
crates/om9-app/src/ui.rs: SmartTrack enable/disable, all-view guides, one-shot badge, E/M shortcuts, viewport focus release
crates/om9-app/src/ui/chrome.rs: icon_toggle and Project section-bar control
crates/om9-app/src/ui/sidebar_palettes.rs: clickable snap state, Project and SmartTrack toggles

checks.name: snap/selection regressions
checks.command: cargo test -p om9-app --test snap_panel_modes --test osnap_ui --test osnap_brep -j 2

remaining: Manual M02-UI visual review of palette state, Project behavior, one-shot indicator and SmartTrack guides.
Grid Snap remains a present-but-disabled palette control; this L2 records object snap and Ortho/Planar/Project.
App-wide clippy/fmt has pre-existing issues outside this module.
not_claimed: QymCAD pinned-source reuse or a build-time QymCAD dependency
